about:
Savoy Contract Furniture traces its roots to 1946 when John D. Savoy and his son John A. Savoy established Savoy's Machine Woodcarving Shop in Montoursville, Pennsylvania. The family-owned business began as a woodcarving operation before evolving into a contract furniture manufacturer serving the commercial market.

Today the company produces a broad line of contract furniture, with a catalog that includes items such as the 5480-REST, UR-ML2020-20-QS, 2805-HPSE-QS, and BBS-SAFE-QS series. Its manufacturing capabilities encompass wood furniture fabrication, machine woodcarving, and assembly, all backed by a limited lifetime warranty on products it manufactures to the original purchaser.

The firm serves commercial and institutional customers, though specific industry sectors are not detailed in available sources. Its product numbering system suggests a focus on standardized, quick-ship configurations for office, healthcare, and education environments.

Savoy emphasizes its limited lifetime warranty as a mark of product durability and stands behind its manufacturing quality, a commitment that has underpinned its operation since the post-war era.
